name: Viewer Forms
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Puts viewer form submissions on stream. The forms site sends each approved submission here; it joins the queue its form is linked to, and the Spotlight widget shows each one as it is taken from the front of that queue.

settings.label: Webhook signing secret
settings.description: The signing secret the forms site shows next to your webhook URL. Requests not signed with it are refused.

resources.name: Form link
resources.description: Connects a form on the forms site to the queue its approved submissions join.

schema.label: Form id
schema.description: The form's id on the forms site, shown in its share settings.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: The queue approved submissions join. Point a Spotlight widget at the same queue to show them.

triggers.name: Forms site webhook
triggers.description: Paste this URL into the forms site's webhook settings. Every request is checked against the signing secret before anything fires.

triggers.name: Form submission approved
triggers.description: Fires when the forms site sends an approved submission for a linked form.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Only submissions headed for this queue. Leave it as any to act on every form.

triggers.sentence: a form submission is approved for {queue}

fields.description: The forms site's id for the submission. This is the queue entry.
The queue it joins, by canonical id.
Who submitted it. Empty for an anonymous submission.

triggers.name: Form submission withdrawn
triggers.description: Fires when the forms site takes back a submission it approved.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: Only submissions in this queue. Leave it as any to act on every form.

triggers.sentence: a form submission is withdrawn from {queue}

fields.description: The queue it was sent to, by canonical id.

actions.name: Show form submission
actions.description: Put a submission on every Spotlight widget watching the queue. An entry that is not a form submission is left alone, so this can follow any queue.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: The queue whose Spotlight widgets show it.

schema.label: Entry
schema.description: The queue entry, which is the submission's id.

fields.description: Whether the entry was a form submission that could be shown.

actions.name: Hide form submission
actions.description: Clear the Spotlight widgets watching the queue.

schema.label: Queue
schema.description: The queue whose Spotlight widgets to clear.

workflows.name: Show form submissions as they are taken from a queue

widgets.name: Form Spotlight
widgets.description: Shows the form submission most recently taken from a queue, until the next one is taken or it is hidden.

settingsSchema.label: Queue
settingsSchema.description: The queue a form is linked to. Each submission taken from it shows here.
